typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ApplicationName as string (),
	ApprovalEmailRecipients as string (),
	ApprovedFilePath as string (),
	AutoApproveInd as integer (),
	BaseFilePath as string (),
	CountRequests as integer (),
	FileCreatedLogMsg as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	GetRequests as string (),
	GroupID as string (),
	NeedsApprovalFilePath as string (),
	RequestID as integer (),
	StartDateTime as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		AG_CSPI_ID as string,
		PHONE_5 as string,
		STATE as string,
		FIRSTNAME as string,
		REQUEST_ID as integer,
		PHONE_2 as string,
		PHONE_1 as string,
		PHONE_4 as string,
		PRACTITIONER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PHONE_3 as string,
		PORTAL_LOB as string,
		SALESFORCE_CAMPAIGN_ID as string,
		LASTNAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		AG_MARKET as string,
		RECORD_ID as long,
		GENDER as string,
		TRANSFER_OFFER_1 as string,
		PROVIDER_GROUPFACILITY_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS1 as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS2 as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		RENEWAL_MONTH as integer,
		PRACTITIONER_LAST_NAME as string,
		ZIPCODE as string,
		CITY as string,
		AG_GROUP as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		AG_PRODUCT as string,
		RECERT_DT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT M.RecordID AS RECORD_ID,  R.RequestID AS REQUEST_ID, M.SubscriberID AS MEMBER_ID,  M.FirstName AS FIRSTNAME, M.LAStName AS LASTNAME,  M.Phone1 AS PHONE_1, M.Phone2 AS PHONE_2, M.Phone3 AS PHONE_3, M.Phone4 AS PHONE_4, M.Phone5 AS PHONE_5, M.Gender AS GENDER, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), M.BirthDate, 101) AS DOB, M.Address1 AS ADDRESS1, M.Address2 AS ADDRESS2,                     M.City AS CITY, M.St AS [STATE], M.Zip AS ZIPCODE, M.CallLanguage AS [LANGUAGE], M.ApplicationName AS APPLICATION_NAME, M.GroupID AS AG_GROUP, M.ProductID AS AG_PRODUCT, M.MarketID AS AG_MARKET, M.PlanID AS AG_CSPI_ID, M.PortalLOB AS PORTAL_LOB, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), M.RecertDate,101) AS RECERT_DT,  M.SFCampaignID AS SALESFORCE_CAMPAIGN_ID, M.TransferOffer AS TRANSFER_OFFER_1,  M.RenewalMonth AS RENEWAL_MONTH, M.PracFirstName AS PRACTITIONER_FIRST_NAME,  M.PracLastName AS PRACTITIONER_LAST_NAME, M.GrpFacName AS PROVIDER_GROUPFACILITY_NAME FROM dbo.MasterRecords M INNER JOIN dbo.Requests R 	ON M.RequestID = R.RequestID WHERE R.RequestID = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetMasterRecords
GetMasterRecords sink(input(
		AG_CSPI_ID as string,
		PHONE_5 as string,
		STATE as string,
		FIRSTNAME as string,
		REQUEST_ID as string,
		PHONE_2 as string,
		PHONE_1 as string,
		PHONE_4 as string,
		PRACTITIONER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		PHONE_3 as string,
		PORTAL_LOB as string,
		SALESFORCE_CAMPAIGN_ID as string,
		LASTNAME as string,
		DOB as string,
		AG_MARKET as string,
		RECORD_ID as string,
		GENDER as string,
		TRANSFER_OFFER_1 as string,
		PROVIDER_GROUPFACILITY_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS1 as string,
		APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS2 as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		RENEWAL_MONTH as string,
		PRACTITIONER_LAST_NAME as string,
		ZIPCODE as string,
		CITY as string,
		AG_GROUP as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		AG_PRODUCT as string,
		RECERT_DT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AG_CSPI_ID,
		PHONE_5,
		STATE,
		FIRSTNAME,
		REQUEST_ID,
		PHONE_2,
		PHONE_1,
		PHONE_4,
		PRACTITIONER_FIRST_NAME,
		PHONE_3,
		PORTAL_LOB,
		SALESFORCE_CAMPAIGN_ID,
		LASTNAME,
		DOB,
		AG_MARKET,
		RECORD_ID,
		GENDER,
		TRANSFER_OFFER_1,
		PROVIDER_GROUPFACILITY_NAME,
		ADDRESS1,
		APPLICATION_NAME,
		ADDRESS2,
		LANGUAGE,
		RENEWAL_MONTH,
		PRACTITIONER_LAST_NAME,
		ZIPCODE,
		CITY,
		AG_GROUP,
		MEMBER_ID,
		AG_PRODUCT,
		RECERT_DT)) ~> CreateIndividualCSVs
